description: Reader-facing text leads for editorial and synthetic-proof slop. Seed patterns, deliberately narrow; they surface candidates for the editorial review contract and never conclude on their own.

rules.message: Superlative or transformation claim with no measurable content nearby (most advanced, revolutionize, unparalleled, cutting-edge, industry-leading).
rules.false_positive_guard: A superlative directly supported by a cited measurement or named comparison is legitimate; read the surrounding block before reporting.

rules.message: Audience-free empowerment filler that survives transplant to any product (unlock your full potential, empowering professionals everywhere).
rules.false_positive_guard: Empowerment language tied to a named user, task, and observable result is legitimate voice; test sentence portability before reporting.

rules.message: Placeholder text (lorem ipsum) is visible in shipped reader-facing content.
rules.false_positive_guard: A page that is explicitly a template specimen or type sample may show placeholder text by design; confirm the surface is user-facing product UI before reporting.

rules.message: A trust-by-numbers claim (Trusted by N users/leaders/companies) with no named or linked source in the claim itself.
rules.false_positive_guard: The same claim adjacent to named customers, a case-study link, or a counting methodology is legitimate; operate the surrounding links before reporting.

rules.message: Unfalsifiable security-grade claim (bank-grade, military-grade) naming no standard, audit, or control.
rules.false_positive_guard: The same words next to a named certification or audit report are legitimate; confirm nothing on the page resolves the claim before reporting.

rules.message: Star-rating decoration or a self-declared score (Rated N/N) citing no review source, count, or link.
rules.false_positive_guard: Ratings that resolve to a named review platform with a count are legitimate proof; operate the badge before reporting.

rules.message: Award or certification badge naming no awarding body (Best X 20NN, Certified Excellence).
rules.false_positive_guard: An award naming its body and year with a resolvable reference is legitimate; confirm the badge resolves nowhere before reporting.
